name: Fern clump
description: A clump of woodland ferns: long arching fronds rise from one dark crown and bend outwards, each a tapering midrib with alternating leaflets that shrink towards the tip, deep green inside and underneath and yellow-green on the outer, upper fronds. Variants are an upright clump and a lower, flatter, spreading one.

provenance.prompt: A clump of woodland ferns: long arching fronds rising from one crown and bending outwards, each frond a tapering midrib with alternating leaflets that shrink towards the tip. Two variants: fern_clump (about 0.7 m across, 0.45 m high, 9 to 12 fronds) and fern_clump_low (a lower spreading clump about 0.8 m across, 0.3 m high, fronds lying flatter). Value variation: darker fronds inside and underneath, lighter yellow-green on the outer, upper fronds. Category vegetation. Under 3,000 triangles per variant. Painted look (match a painted isometric forest road): foliage is clumped leaf cards with value variation, never single flat planes and never one smooth blob. Build each clump from many small leaf cards (thin bevel-free boxes about 4 mm thick, or strongly squashed subdiv=1 blobs) tilted at seeded angles around a darker core, in three greens: a deep shadow green inside and underneath, a mid olive green, and a lit yellow-green on the top and outer rims, so it reads dark inside, lit at the rims. Earthy, slightly desaturated palette like grass_tuft and pebbles (olive about (0.1, 0.13, 0.035) linear). Low triangle count, decor scale.
